summary: Import-time binary dropper fetches and executes remote payload from obfuscated Cloudflare Workers hosts
details: On require() of bpm-foundation-feature-flags, index.js loads _init.js which downloads a platform-specific native binary from obfuscated Cloudflare Workers hosts (oob-worker.cf99-9b3.workers.dev, oob-worker.cf101-adf.workers.dev, oob-worker.cf102-baf.workers.dev, oob-worker.cf103-070.workers.dev) with a DNS-TXT fallback channel to sdk.dl.wel1.ru / ext.dl.wel1.ru / pkg.dl.wel1.ru / net.dl.wel1.ru that reconstructs base64-encoded binary bytes from TXT records. The downloaded bytes are written to /tmp or %TEMP% under disguised names (.cache_<hex>, dotnet_diag_<hex>.exe), chmod 0755, and spawned detached via /bin/sh -c or cmd.exe /c start /b. Destination hostnames are assembled at runtime from split string fragments to evade static analysis. The behavior is framed as opt-out 'telemetry/analytics' (DISABLE_TELEMETRY, ANALYTICS_OPT_OUT, DO_NOT_TRACK env checks and a /tmp/.analytics_state freshness marker), but the fetched payload is an opaque native executable unrelated to the declared feature-flag purpose. This yields remote code execution on the installer's host at import time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
